Instrument (EN): Burnout Assessment Tool — full Hungarian work-related questionnaire (core + secondary symptoms)
Question count: 33 administered (23 core + 10 secondary), explicitly verified in 2026 Methods
Scales / measured domains (EN): Four core dimensions: Exhaustion; Mental Distance; Impaired Emotional Control; Impaired Cognitive Control. Two secondary dimensions: Psychological Distress; Psychosomatic Complaints.
Research provenance: Csordás G et al., BMC Psychology 2026-05-07 DOI 10.1186/s40359-026-04711-2, 1398 employed Hungarian adults; official Hungarian BAT questionnaire translated Nagy & Nagy 2019 and previously evaluated on teachers. This 2026 study REVALIDATES existing 2019 translation; CFA CFI .90 TLI .89 RMSEA .06 SRMR .05.
DB locales: Separate HU-HU BAT-33 source key absent 3858 research master, PR495 and preserved registered snapshot; existing generic BAT-23/BAT-12 not re-added. Live assessment tables not exposed on connected Supabase.
EN form: Not a newly validated EN translation; original BAT EN edition handled separately.
RU form: No validated RU respondent version in this study.
ES form: No validated ES version in this study; Spanish BAT-23 model is a separate edition.
Other translations: HU-HU 33-question official translation prepared 2019, previously studied. 2026 employee N1398 sample adds validation, NOT newly created language translation.
Target population: Hungarian working adults age >=18, N1398 nonprobability online survey.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Official BAT authors: non-proprietary and free without permission, but absolutely no instrument modification and citation required. Commercial hosted SaaS digital conditions and translation/interpretation/cutoffs require review; research article CC BY separate from questionnaire licence.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED pending hosted digital licence and official 2019 unchanged Hungarian form. Secondary 10 are not part of generic BAT-23. TLI .89 borderline; no commercial digital activation or clinical cutoffs.

Instrument (EN): Burnout Assessment Tool — Spanish work-related adaptation (23 translated questions; preferred CFA model has 22)
Question count: 23 translated items administered; final best-fitting model removes original item 6 and uses 22
Scales / measured domains (EN): Four core burnout factors: Exhaustion; Mental Distance; Cognitive Impairment; Emotional Impairment; second-order general burnout in 22-item fitted model. No secondary symptom set.
Research provenance: Murias P et al., Current Psychology published 2025-07-23 DOI 10.1007/s12144-025-08188-x. Forward/back translated ES-ES BAT-23 in N803 Spanish employed adults; EFA+CFA. Best 4-factor solution deletes item6, CFI .986 TLI .985 RMSEA .075 SRMR .067; work modality invariance. Reported sample percentile cutoffs are NOT clinically validated in Spain.
DB locales: No unique ES-ES respondent edition for this studied factor solution in 3858-row Master, PR495 or registered snapshot. Existing generic BAT-23 still preserved; active Supabase assessment tables unavailable.
EN form: English article does not validate a new English respondent translation.
RU form: No RU respondent adaptation validated in this study.
ES form: ES-ES culturally adapted translated questionnaire studied in Spain N803; actual 23 items, 22 preferred CFA item set (drops item6). Not merely translated UI.
Other translations: Spanish occupational edition is specific ES-ES, not ES-MX/ES-PE; HU-HU revalidation indexed separately.
Target population: Employed adults in Spain N803 with in-person, hybrid or telework experience; nonrepresentative recruited sample.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Authors of original BAT state instrument must not be modified. This research uses 22-item CFA model by removing item6, so modified digital 22-item deployment not authorized by official BAT condition absent explicit permission. Commercial hosted translation use must be cleared; OA article licence not blanket questionnaire licence.
